messages.content: Hey — what can I help you with today?

Hi Eman! Main ChatGPT hoon. Aap kaisay hain?  
Aap kis cheez mein madad chahte hain—study, kaam, writing, ya koi aur baat?

Apna goal dhoondhnay ke liye sab se pehle yeh clear karna hota hai ke aapko kis cheez se *energy* milti hai aur aap kis cheez mein *naturally achay* hain. Main aapko 10–15 minute mein direction nikalwanay ke liye kuch short questions poochta/poochti hoon—bas inka jawab de dein:

1) Aap ki umar (approx) aur aap abhi kya kar rahe hain? (school/college/job/ghar)  
2) Aapko konsi cheezen karna pasand hain? 3 cheezen likhein.  
3) Konsi cheezen aapko bilkul pasand nahi? 3 cheezen.  
4) Aap kis cheez mein achay/achi hain? (log kya kehtay hain?)  
5) Aapko kis tarah ka kaam suit karta hai:  
   - logon ke saath (teaching/sales/helping)  
   - computer/tech  
   - creative (design/writing)  
   - business/management  
   - hands-on (craft/field work)  
6) Aap ki priority kya hai: paisa, passion, stability, ya azadi? (top 2)  
7) Agar 6 months mein ek skill seekhni ho jo aapki life change kar de—konsi?

Aap in 7 questions ke answers bhej dein, main aapke liye:
- 2–3 suitable goals propose karoon ga/gi  
- unke liye 30-day practical plan bhi bana doon ga/gi.
Haan, bilkul. Aap mujhse kuch bhi pooch sakte hain—kis baare mein poochna hai?
